title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Yield-relief rally, health care led, semis bled. Treasury buyback surprise crushed long yields, igniting gold/silver/miners and pharma while AI hardware sold off on spending fears. Broad tape positive but narrow leadership.

INDICES — VIX 14.9, down from 16.3 20d MA. IWM +0.50%, DIA +0.26%, SPY +0.21%, QQQ -0.20%, SOXX -2.21%. Small > large by 0.29pp. Gold +3.84%, dollar -0.92%. SPY above 200d, QQQ above 200d.

VOLUME — SPY vol_ratio 1.0x neutral, QQQ not listed. GLD 2.1x and IBIT 4.2x show heavy accumulation in metals and BTC proxies; KRE 2.1x with -2.41% signals bank distribution. DIA 0.8x and IJR 0.7x — large and small caps being ignored.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLV Healthcare +3.52%, XLY Discretionary +1.26%, XLP Staples +1.26%, XLRE Real Estate +1.26%, XLK Technology +0.00%, XLI Industrials +0.00%, XLC Comms +0.00%, XLF Financials +0.00%, XLB Materials +0.00%, XLU Utilities +0.00%, XLE Energy -2.76%. Top SILJ +9.55%, GDX +9.42%; bottom KBE -2.10%, KRE -2.41%. Money rotating into health care and precious metals, out of banks and semis. Rotation state: AI hardware fading / high-to-low rotation.

POSITIONING — QQQ PCR 1.05 elevated with skew +8.4% = put demand; SPY PCR 0.80 complacent. IWM PCR 2.06 extreme protection, GEX flip 264 vs spot above — dealer hedging could amplify downside if Russell breaks. VIX below 20d MA, no fear.

CROSS-ASSET — Gold +3.84% with dollar -0.92% — classic inverse dollar/gold chain, amplified by Treasury buyback news. Silver +4.47% outperforming gold signals industrial demand bid.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Neutral 51.1. MRK +12.60% on vaccine data (vol 4.0x, accumulation), AEM +11.12% on gold surge, MRVL +9.85% on semi bid (vol 2.0x). 20d momentum: XLE best, SOXX worst at -6.45%. Watch GLD +3.84% — 2.1x vol near gamma flip 404; IWM +0.50% — PCR 2.06 stretched with QQQ -0.20% divergence; MRVL +9.85% — semi bounce against SOXX -2.21% trend break.
